facts.fact: 开章：Taesia=怨恨生物——「Let me have my resentment. Let me turn their dream of divinity into a nightmare. I’ll teach them what immortality means.」
facts.anchor: Taesia Lastrider was a creature of resentment.

facts.fact: 蹲守：Vitae portal house 顶（双子日暗折里）——尾随 Ulshära 自 Zenith Tower 至 Aurora Tower 再至 portal house——杀她比当年潜入杀 Kaspan 更易——「something told her not yet」。
facts.anchor: It would have been easy to end her then and there.

facts.fact: 神的军需观：Nyx 视军团为一次性武器（onetime weapons）——她夜访神选营、指间织影——「If she couldn't dull a weapon already forged, she could at least stop another from being made」。
facts.anchor: They are not meant for survival,

facts.fact: Starfell：黑棘刃=cosmic beast 之骨——星质与她、与 Nyx 共鸣——「half of his beloved fulcrum」。
facts.anchor: Its star matter resonated with hers,

facts.fact: 主体性宣言：「It was she, not Nyx, who had made the choice to run her sword through an imperator's chest and call it just」——屠夫之名是自选的。
黑洞 2.0：缺半 crux（当年靠 Lilia Lunari）——造出 antithesis/antimatter——吸食未命名星辰之核「until they learned to covet each syllable of her name」；「This could be my only way back」——但她知道还有别的路（Phos 被逐出 Noctus 的燃烧尾迹）。
庭院变局：Ulshära 撤离——Dante（lightsbane 镣铐）！绿眼与火春死之气味——Rian：「Alive. Alive. Alive.」——Starfell 记得他血的味道、虚空想要认领。

反手一挥：黑洞不吃 portal house 而扑向 Aurora Tower——erase it from existence（只剩基座如半月笑）——吞噬全城成走廊、sated whisper 消失；有人仰头穿过暗影寻她（eyeshine+longing）——「What does a nightmare have to fear but its ending? / A better dream.」——她开门消失。
